notes: For each cell the side of the largest fertile square ending there: 1 plus the least of the cells above, to the left and diagonally up-left, kept in two rows. Checking every square cell by cell is right and hopeless on a 40 by 40 map; leaving out the diagonal accepts an L-shape as a square.

traps: a square needs its diagonal neighbour too
a map that is wider than it is tall
one rock in the middle of a fertile map
trying every square cell by cell is over budget
